name: cdk

schema.title: Schema for AWS CDK context files (cdk.json)

description:
The CDK application is started with the command `npx ts-node bin/my-app.ts`, and the project is built using `npm run build`. Version reporting is enabled, so the toolkit will emit version information during execution. In watch mode, the system monitors all TypeScript files under `src/**/*.ts` and JavaScript files under `lib/**/*.js`, while deliberately ignoring any files in `node_modules/**` and the `dist/**` directory.

The context for this deployment is set to a **development** environment in the **us‑east‑1** AWS region. Feature flags are also defined: the “enableBeta” flag is explicitly set to false, ensuring that beta functionality remains turned off.
